name: eng-2351
title: Import Roam templates without a title into Obsidian

prepare.why: the dev graph published a PK Plan node type whose template has a body but no title, as Roam always does, and one node
the Templates core plugin is on with a Templates folder

check.js: (() => { const templates = proof.obsidian.templates(); return templates.enabled && templates.folder === 'Templates' && Boolean(proof.obsidian.file('Templates')); })()

prepare.why: the vault has no PK Plan type, note or template file from an earlier import

apply.js: (async () => { await proof.obsidian.closeModals(); await proof.obsidian.removeFiles([...proof.obsidian.importedFiles(['pk-2351-roam-plan']), proof.obsidian.file('Templates/PK Plan (from discourse-dev-graph).md')]); await proof.obsidian.removeNodeTypes(['PK Plan']); proof.obsidian.clearNotices(); })()

cases.title: A template without a title gets a file named after its type and space
cases.caption: Roam publishes a template's body but never a title, so imports used to skip it. Now Obsidian creates the template as PK Plan, from discourse dev graph, and assigns it to the new node type.

steps.why: open import the way a user would
wait for the shared nodes to load

do.js: proof.waitFor(() => /Successfully imported|Import completed/.test(proof.obsidian.notices()), { what: 'the import to finish', timeout: 30000 })

expect.js: (async () => { await proof.waitFor(() => { const type = proof.obsidian.nodeType('PK Plan'); return type && type.template === 'PK Plan (from discourse-dev-graph)'; }, { what: 'PK Plan with its template assigned', timeout: 20000 }); const file = proof.obsidian.file('Templates/PK Plan (from discourse-dev-graph).md'); proof.assert(file, 'No template file at Templates/PK Plan (from discourse-dev-graph).md.'); const text = await window.app.vault.read(file); proof.assert(text.includes('Done when'), 'The template file is missing the template body.'); })()

cases.title: The template file holds the template from Roam
cases.caption: The template file holds the body from Roam, ready for new plans.

expect.js: proof.assert(window.app.workspace.getActiveFile().basename === 'PK Plan (from discourse-dev-graph)', 'The template file is not open.')
